Brass-plated single-action revolver with a mother-of-pearl grip, cylinder etched with gear-motifs, holstered low at her right hip.
Twin pepperbox pistols holstered crossed at her waist, brass barrels gleaming in clusters of six, leather grips worn smooth.
Brass spyglass on a leather lanyard, lens-cap on a delicate chain, extended to three brass-banded segments.
Clockwork left-arm of brass and copper, fingers individually articulated by exposed gear-trains, a small steam-vent at the elbow.
Sky-compass set in a brass-and-glass housing the size of a pocket-watch, needle trembling on a copper pivot, worn on a chain.
Leather bandolier of brass cannon-shells across her chest, each shell etched with the airship's name in copperplate script.
Brass-and-glass signal-lantern with cut-glass amber shutters, a clockwork shutter-lever cycling signal-patterns at her thumb's press.
Brass-handled cutlass with a pierced basket-hilt, blade etched with sky-route maps, slung in a worn brown leather scabbard.
Brass astrolabe on a broad leather wrist-strap, rotating altitude-rings calibrated in degrees, a sighting-vane hinged at the top.
Brass-fingered gauntlet on her right hand, each knuckle-joint a tiny ratchet-gear, grip-strength amplified by a coiled mainspring in the palm.
Leather tool-belt studded with brass rivets, holding six individual snap-hooks, a fold-out brass rule, and a cartridge-loop row.
Pocket-chronometer in a brass hunting-case, twin subsidiary dials tracking ship-time and port-time simultaneously, chain anchored to her coat-button.
Signal-flare pistol with a bell-mouthed brass barrel, break-action breech, and a rosewood grip banded in copper wire.
Brass-and-glass voltmeter on a leather wrist-strap, copper needle sweeping a semi-circular scale, two wire-probe leads coiled at the back.
Mechanical leg-brace of riveted brass over boiled leather, a knee-joint driven by a clockwork governor that clicks at each stride.
Brass monocle-magnifier on a spring-loaded cord, lens ground to four-power, a secondary red filter on a pivot for chart-reading.
Copper speaking-tube on a coiled hose, a brass bell-mouth at her collar-level, valve-cock sealing it when not in use.
Throwing-knife bandolier across her left forearm, six brass-spined blades sheathed in individual leather pockets, handles wrapped in copper wire.
Brass sextant in a fitted leather case, vernier scale reading to one-tenth of a degree, mirror polished to surgical clarity.
Grenade-belt of riveted brown leather at her waist, holding four ovoid brass grenades, each fused with a pull-ring of copper.
Altitude-meter in a brass drum-case on a wrist-strap, aneroid capsule visible through a small round glass port on the face.
Brass whistle on a plaited leather lanyard, three-toned with individual pitch-ports, clipped to her epaulette ring and always ready.
Single-shot brass-barreled derringer in a wrist-holster of oiled leather, concealed under her cuff, triggered by a spring-loaded flick-mechanism.
Brass-and-jewel cravat-pin housing a hidden compass in its base, the needle readable by unscrewing the filigree cap a quarter-turn.
Gear-eye prosthetic of polished brass in her left socket, iris-aperture adjusting mechanically via a small dial behind her ear.
